description: This file implements cryptographic functions related to TLS protocol, specifically pseudo-random functions (PRFs) for SSL 3.0 and SSL 3.1 used in TLS crypto provider object. It contains functions for computing PRF with different versions of the protocol, including detailed hashing procedures and HMAC calculations.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoCompute_PRF30(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * i_secret,ULONG i_secret_size,void * i_seed,ULONG i_seed_size,void * o_hash,ULONG o_hash_size)
methods.description: Computes the pseudo-random function for SSL 3.0 using MD5 and SHA-1 hashing algorithms, generating output based on secret and seed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoCompute_PRF31(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * i_secret,ULONG i_secret_size,char * i_label,void * i_seed,ULONG i_seed_size,void * o_hash,ULONG o_hash_size)
methods.description: Computes the TLS PRF for SSL 3.1, utilizing HMAC-MD5 and HMAC-SHA-1 based on secret, label, and seed, and producing an output of specified size.
